SAUCE http: //www.dilg.com.ph 22 FEB OPINION NO. s. 202 MASAGANA FARMERS ASSOCIATION Sitio Palayan Bayan Nagbalayong Morong, Bataan Dear Mr. Sauce: This is in reference to your letter received by this Department on 24 October 2018 requesting for urgent implementation of the conversion of sitios (Marucdoc, Sampalok, Gantuan and Napot Point) as registered barangay which will be known as Barangay Masagana. Foremost, please be informed that Republic Act 7160 otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC) provides that creation of local government unit, like barangay, needs a law enacted by Congress or an ordinance passed by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan or Panlungsod concerned, viz: SECTION 6. Moreover, other than the passage of a law or ordinance, the LGC also requires that a plebiscite be conducted after the passage of the said law or ordinance. Otherwise stated, the residents of the barangays affected should vote if they are in favor of the creation of the new barangay. It provides: SECTION. IO. Plebiscite Requirement. - No creation, division, merger, abolition, or substantial alteration of boundaries of local government units shall take effect unless approved by a majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite called for thepurpose in thepolitical unit or units directly affected. Saidplebiscite shall be conducted by the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) within one hundred twenty (120) days from the date of effectivity of the law or ordinance effecting such action, unless said law or ordinance fixes another date. In your letter, this Department observed that these requirements mentioned above have not been complied with. In addition, it is not within the power of this Department to order the Congress or Sangguniang Panlalawigan of the Province of Bataan to pass the law/ordinance creating barangay Masagana as this matter is within the discretion of the Congress or the said Sanggunian. Please be guided accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: C. SACENDONCILLO Undersecretary Copy furnished: Dir. Julie J.
